title: Messenger Header Button Conversion
desc: Converted the top header messenger icon from an awkward floating popup into a direct single-click navigation button to streamline access to the chat workspace.

title: Notification-to-Chat Deep Linking
desc: Integrated deep linking from notification toasts directly into specific chat conversations, automatically opening the sender's thread upon clicking the alert.

title: Sticky Headers for Lead Management Tables
desc: Fixed the scrolling layout across lead management tables by locking the table headers in place so only the table body rows scroll, keeping columns clear.

title: Sticky Table Header for Finance Ledger
desc: Implemented fixed table header positioning on the Finance dashboard ledger, preventing the header from scrolling out of view when reviewing large payment queues.

title: Lead Refund Request Submission Workflow
desc: Built the frontend interface and backend endpoints for initiating lead refund requests, capturing refund amount, reason, and client bank details.

title: Refund Review and Approval Engine
desc: Developed approval logic allowing authorized managers to inspect, approve, or reject refund requests with dedicated audit logs and status transitions.

title: Finance Refund Payout Processing Modal
desc: Created a payout modal for finance officers to record transaction IDs, payout dates, and disbursement notes when funds are transferred back to clients.

title: Total Refund KPI Card on Finance Dashboard
desc: Added a dedicated Total Refund metric box to the Finance dashboard, calculating cumulative refunded amounts and lead counts for real-time visibility.

title: Payments Dashboard Net Revenue Deduction
desc: Integrated total refund statistics into the Payments overview dashboard, automatically deducting refunded amounts from gross collections to calculate net income.

title: Refund Data Columns in CSV Ledger Export
desc: Enhanced payments CSV reporting by adding refund status and refunded amount columns, ensuring financial exports match exact audited balance sheets.

title: Real-Time Emoji Reactions Socket Pipeline
desc: Built backend services, controllers, and socket event emitters (`chat:reaction`) enabling live emoji reactions on chat messages across all connected clients.

title: Non-Breaking Metadata Encoding Architecture
desc: Engineered a comment-based encoding mechanism for message replies, forwards, and reactions to deliver WhatsApp features with zero database schema migrations.
